queries.errors: SELECT start_timestamp, span_id, parent_span_id, span_name, exception_type, exception_message, attributes->>'chat_session_id' AS chat_session_id FROM records WHERE trace_id = '01a0f4b134ef6d7c5f9de3bc8d0e596f' AND is_exception ORDER BY start_timestamp LIMIT 100
queries.branch_failures: SELECT span_name, attributes->>'failure_kind' AS failure_kind, attributes->>'exception_type' AS exception_type, count(*) AS count FROM records WHERE trace_id = '01a0f4b134ef6d7c5f9de3bc8d0e596f' AND span_name = 'retrieval_branch_failed' GROUP BY span_name, attributes->>'failure_kind', attributes->>'exception_type' LIMIT 20
queries.case_spans: SELECT span_id, parent_span_id, span_name, start_timestamp, duration FROM records WHERE trace_id = '01a0f4b134ef6d7c5f9de3bc8d0e596f' AND span_name LIKE 'case:%' ORDER BY start_timestamp LIMIT 110
queries.operational_details: SELECT start_timestamp, span_id, parent_span_id, span_name, message, attributes FROM records WHERE trace_id = '01a0f4b134ef6d7c5f9de3bc8d0e596f' AND (span_name = 'retrieval_branch_failed' OR span_name = 'chat_session.guidance') ORDER BY start_timestamp LIMIT 100
queries.SYN-T14-04-errors: SELECT start_timestamp, span_name, message, http_response_status_code, exception_type, exception_message, attributes->>'error.type' AS error_type, attributes->>'http.response.status_code' AS response_status FROM records WHERE trace_id = '01a0f4b134ef6d7c5f9de3bc8d0e596f' AND (http_response_status_code >= 400 OR level >= 17 OR exception_type IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY start_timestamp LIMIT 40
